cohort.label: GEMINI_MUTATION_COHORT_V1
cohort.note: CONTINUOUS-8: REAL FILL -> COHERENT AUTHORITATIVE REFRESH -> INVENTORY CHANGE -> CHANGED L5 ACTION, entered EARLY (240-280s TTE) by experimental scheduling rather than by dispatch accident. BUDGET 12 = CP.MAX_ACTIONS, the EXISTING frozen envelope ceiling: this is LIFECYCLE CAPACITY for a window that runs ~2x longer, not financial risk. Every absolute bound is unchanged -- $0.15 spend, 0.04 residual, 0.04 imbalance, 0.10 per leg, 0.01 size, MOC maker-only, no pair-cost ceiling. LINEAGE, EXPLICIT: chained to C7's ledger, NOT to C8's. verify_predecessor is SINGLE-HOP, so whichever ledger this names is the only one whose bytes this cohort enforces before the latch -- and C8's ledger is EMPTY, carrying no mutation history to protect. Chaining to it would have left C7's six spent slots unguarded by the live path. C5/C6/C7 chained to the last cohort that had actually consumed slots; those coincided with the immediate predecessor until now. C8 (0/6) is ABANDONED, kept byte-for-byte, never to be used, and pinned by test rather than by this chain.
cohort.labels: the cohort budget is a TIGHTENING of the envelope, never an extension of it. No rollover, no automatic successor.
